scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem concerns single nonlinear central isotype projections on finite generalized dihedral groups with normalized counting measure. It establishes endpoint norms only; intermediate p-norms, noncentral multipliers, and unions of isotypes are not claimed. The finite verifier is corroborative, not a substitute for the analytic proof. A 2024 complex dihedral idempotent paper is retained as a specific originality risk because its accessible body could not be inspected through the available full-text interface.
title: Exact endpoint norms of nonlinear isotype projections on generalized dihedral groups
